installed_optimization_packages.parameter_space: Continuous bounded box [lower, upper] via BoundTransform / ScaleCoordinates
installed_optimization_packages.vectorized_objective_support: Semi-supported (ask-and-tell API returns list of candidates; user evaluates in batch and tells scores)
Supported via vectorized=True (passes 2D array [N, params] to objective function)

in_repo_sce_implementation.algorithm: SCE-UA (Shuffled Complex Evolution - University of Arizona; Duan et al. 1992, 1993)
in_repo_sce_implementation.is_wrapper_or_custom: Custom in-repo PyTorch implementation directly coupled to UnifiedEvaluator.score_batched

answers_to_mandatory_audit_questions.1_is_it_really_sce_ua: No installed site-packages library contains SCE-UA. The installed packages provide CMA-ES (cma, evotorch), Differential Evolution (scipy.optimize), and Deep Learning (dmg, hydrodl2). SCE-UA is implemented directly in-repo at project/autofuse/sce.py.
answers_to_mandatory_audit_questions.2_is_it_consistent_with_sce_baseline: The in-repo SCEBaseline is the only SCE-UA implementation. The other installed optimizers (CMA-ES, DE) are distinct evolutionary algorithms with different search dynamics, population update rules, and convergence characteristics.
answers_to_mandatory_audit_questions.3_repository_sce_origin: Standalone in-repo implementation written specifically for the Auto-FUSE / Torch-FUSE framework to reproduce the 78-structure FUSE paper calibration protocol on PyTorch GPU without Fortran binaries.

4_advanced_features_in_installed_package.cma: Ask-and-tell interface allows candidate batching, full covariance adaptation, active CMA.
4_advanced_features_in_installed_package.scipy_de: vectorized=True passes 2D matrix to objective, worker pool parallelization.
4_advanced_features_in_installed_package.evotorch: Native PyTorch SolutionBatch evaluation, ray-based multi-actor parallelization, GPU-native tensors.
